name: strata
title: Strata
description: A CV drawn as a borehole log: black linework on a white sheet, each role a stratum hatched as sand, clay, gravel or rock, dates at each boundary; prints on A4.

tokens.--font-head: drafting capitals: name, headings, menu, labels, dates
tokens.--text-xs: column labels of the log and labels of the cells
tokens.--text-s: menu, dates, places, the footer key, CV links
tokens.--text-m: reading size, and role titles in the log
tokens.--text-l: site title, opening lines, a role's summary, headings in text
tokens.--text-xl: the home headline beside the log, a role page's title
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles, the name on the CV, the home headline with no log
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the drafting capitals
tokens.--color-bg: the log sheet: every page's background
tokens.--color-text: black ink: text, headings, role titles
tokens.--color-muted: lighter ink: places, labels, notes, footer, list dashes
tokens.--color-accent: clay brown: links, role arrows, the current menu bar, quote and kicker rules
tokens.--color-line: linework: borders of the sheet, cells and menu, strata boundaries, the level mark, big depth ticks
tokens.--color-tick: small depth ticks and thin table and list rules
tokens.--color-panel: the shaded label row over the log, table heads, hovers
tokens.--color-hatch: hatching in the legend, the turf at ground level, the strip under page titles
tokens.--wash-sand: buff wash under sand and gravel and the title strip; top band of the site mark
tokens.--wash-clay: wash under clay dashes; middle band of the site mark
tokens.--wash-chalk: wash under rock courses; bottom band of the site mark
tokens.--depth-width: the date column at the left of the log
tokens.--space-3: normal gap; side margin on a phone
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks; side margin on wider screens
tokens.--space-5: largest gap: beside the log, below the content
tokens.--rule-heavy: thickness of the sheet border and heavy rules
tokens.--radius: corners of code, images and the Print button
